english.title: Occupier of a dwelling permit overcrowding
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the occupier of a dwelling at **(..SPECIFY ADDRESS..), permitted it to be overcrowded in that **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF OVERCROWDING ..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 327(1) and (3) of the Housing Act 1985.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
occupier of a dwelling
permitted overcrowding

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Section 327(2)provides that the occupier is not guilty of an offence - (a)if the overcrowding is within the exceptions specified in section 328 or 329(children attaining age of 10 or visiting relatives), or (b) by reason of anythingdone under the authority of, and in accordance with any conditions specifiedin, a licence granted by the local housing authority under section 330.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)the defendant, being the occupier of a dwelling at **(..SPECIFY ADDRESS..), permitted it to be overcrowded in that **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF OVERCROWDING..).

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level two on the standard scale and, for every day subsequent to the date of conviction that the offence continues, to a fine not exceeding one-tenth of level two.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
